intro: Choose how this browser reaches the hub. The choice sticks across visits and does not change on reconnect or connectivity checks — only when you switch it here.
mode_footer: Home uses LAN addresses; Away uses outside addresses. Switching opens that address's page (same hub, another path).
addresses_footer: Addresses come from this page and from the hub's hello (public URL and endpoints). Other hubs stay under Hubs in General.
empty: No addresses yet. Open the hub from another path once, or wait for hello to advertise endpoints.
empty_mode: No addresses for this mode yet.
